title: one problem becomes one budgeted prompt
question: does `bb pinpoint` write a prompt that fits, naming the files and the gate?
rule: README: PACKED is the one `bb pinpoint` prompt for the task.

steps.name: it locates a problem and reports a verdict
steps.run: node bin/bb.js pinpoint "the token estimator under-counts code"

steps.name: and names the files it chose
steps.run: node bin/bb.js pinpoint "the token estimator under-counts code" --json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).scope.length?'has-scope':'no-scope'))"
